tools.description: Take a film off its public page (back to draft). Viewers who already bought or rented it keep their access.

tools.description: Turn a film's plain director and cast text lines into credit rows (Director for the director line, Actor for each comma-separated cast name), appended after the existing credits, and clear the lines — the film editor's convert button. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_embed_code, start_video_upload, get_upload_status, publish_film, update_filmmaker_profile · Private data: update_video, delete_video, start_video_upload, upload_video_from_chat, get_upload_status, create_film, start_film_upload · Public sink: get_embed_code, start_video_upload, upload_video_from_chat, get_upload_status, get_film, create_film, update_film, publish_film, invite_film_credit, start_film_upload · Destructive: delete_video, remove_film_credit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_embed_code, start_video_upload, get_upload_status, publish_film, update_filmmaker_profile · Private data: update_video, delete_video, start_video_upload, upload_video_from_chat, get_upload_status, create_film, start_film_upload · Public sink: get_embed_code, start_video_upload, upload_video_from_chat, get_upload_status, get_film, create_film, update_film, publish_film, invite_film_credit, start_film_upload · Destructive: delete_video, remove_film_credit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
